title: Client Linux
description: Interfaces, sondes de latence, tests iperf3, routes et ressources d'un client du lab.

list.name: node
list.label: Client
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "lab_node" WITH KEY = "node" WHERE "role" = 'client' AND $timeFilter
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "lab_node" WITH KEY = "node" WHERE "role" = 'client' AND $timeFilter

targets.query: SELECT last("os") AS "value" FROM "lab_node" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("mgmt_ipv4") AS "value" FROM "lab_node" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("uptime_s") FROM "lab_node" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND time > now() - 1m

panels.title: Configuré
panels.description: Au moins une adresse IPv4 du lab (hors management).

targets.query: SELECT last("ready") FROM "lab_node" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND time > now() - 1m

panels.title: Processus
panels.description: Processus vus dans le conteneur, zombies compris. Une hausse continue signale des processus non récoltés par le PID 1.

targets.query: SELECT last("processes") FROM "lab_node" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter
SELECT sum("r") FROM (SELECT last("reachable") AS "r" FROM "lab_probe" WHERE "src" =~ /^$node$/ AND time > now() - 1m GROUP BY "target")
SELECT count("r") FROM (SELECT last("reachable") AS "r" FROM "lab_probe" WHERE "src" =~ /^$node$/ AND time > now() - 1m GROUP BY "target")

SELECT last("oper_up") AS "oper", last("mtu") AS "mtu", last("speed_mbps") AS "speed", last("addresses") AS "addresses", last("mac") AS "mac", last("rx_bps") AS "rx", last("tx_bps") AS "tx" FROM "lab_interface" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND time > now() - 1m GROUP BY "interface", "if_type", "peer_node", "peer_interface"

panels.title: Débit par interface
panels.description: Interfaces du lab (le management eth0 est exclu) : émission (tx) au-dessus de l'axe, réception (rx) en dessous.

targets.query: SELECT mean("rx_bps") AS "rx", mean("tx_bps") AS "tx" FROM "lab_interface" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "interface" != 'eth0' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "interface" fill(null)

SELECT mean("rx_pps") AS "rx paquets", mean("tx_pps") AS "tx paquets", mean("rx_errors_ps") AS "rx erreurs", mean("tx_errors_ps") AS "tx erreurs", mean("rx_dropped_ps") AS "rx pertes", mean("tx_dropped_ps") AS "tx pertes" FROM "lab_interface" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "interface" != 'eth0' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "interface" fill(null)
SELECT mean("rtt_avg_ms") FROM "lab_probe" WHERE "src" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "target" fill(null)
SELECT mean("jitter_ms") FROM "lab_probe" WHERE "src" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "target" fill(null)
SELECT mean("loss_pct") FROM "lab_probe" WHERE "src" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "target" fill(null)

SELECT last("rtt_min_ms") AS "min", last("rtt_avg_ms") AS "avg", last("rtt_max_ms") AS "max", last("jitter_ms") AS "jitter", last("loss_pct") AS "loss", last("reachable") AS "reach" FROM "lab_probe" WHERE "src" =~ /^$node$/ AND time > now() - 1m GROUP BY "dst", "dst_interface", "dst_ip"

panels.title: Débit des tests iperf3 (par seconde)
panels.description: Points présents seulement pendant les tests lancés par `make iperf SRC=… DST=…`.

targets.query: SELECT mean("bps") FROM "lab_iperf" WHERE ("src" =~ /^$node$/ OR "dst" =~ /^$node$/) AND "sample" = 'interval' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "src", "dst" fill(null)

defaults.noValue: aucun test iperf3 sur la période (make iperf)

panels.title: Tests iperf3
panels.description: Résumé de chaque test lancé par make iperf SRC=… DST=… ; vide tant qu'aucun test n'a été lancé.

targets.query: SELECT last("received_bps") AS "rcv", last("sent_bps") AS "snt", last("retransmits") AS "retr", last("mean_rtt_ms") AS "rtt", last("duration_s") AS "dur", last("parallel") AS "par" FROM "lab_iperf" WHERE "sample" = 'summary' AND ("src" =~ /^$node$/ OR "dst" =~ /^$node$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "test_id", "src", "dst", "dst_ip"
SELECT last("rib") FROM "lab_route" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "protocol" != 'total' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "afi", "protocol" fill(previous)
SELECT last("count") FROM "lab_neighbor" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "interface", "family", "state" fill(previous)
SELECT mean("usage_percent") FROM "docker_container_cpu" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "cpu" = 'cpu-total' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("usage") FROM "docker_container_mem" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("limit") FROM "docker_container_mem" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)

SELECT non_negative_derivative(last("rx_bytes"), 1s) * 8 AS "rx", non_negative_derivative(last("tx_bytes"), 1s) * 8 AS "tx" FROM "docker_container_net" WHERE "node" =~ /^$node$/ AND "network" = 'total' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
